name: Return to the Bulwark
summary: Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark asks you to bring her a filled bottle from Dalson's Tears. The delivery connects that farmstead to the Forsaken presence in the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: A Bottle for Vandis
sections.body: At the Bulwark in the Western Plaguelands, Shadow Priestess Vandis is waiting for you. You are to bring her the filled bottle from Dalson's Tears, carrying it from the farmstead back to the Forsaken outpost.

faq.q: Who is waiting for the bottle?
faq.answer: Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark is waiting for the filled bottle from Dalson's Tears.

faq.q: Where do I bring the bottle?
faq.answer: Bring the filled bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in the Western Plaguelands.
The filled bottle comes from Dalson's Tears.

attribution: In-game quest text: Return to the Bulwark
